objective: Produce a complete, production-ready frontend redesign of DK Bond Tracker for BOTH web and Android using Stitch CLI as the primary design tool. Design only — ZERO functionality change. Two tracks compete; the developer picks the winner.
invariants: Do NOT modify any application code (src/, android/ app logic, tests). Your worktree receives commits ONLY for evidence files you create (research/, evidence/, DESIGN.md, screenshots).
Preserve every existing route/screen: the screen inventory (web routes from Flask app + Android screens) must each get a redesigned counterpart — none dropped.
Do NOT fix bugs you find — REPORT them in your findings notes instead.
sequence: 1. RESEARCH first: study modern UI/UX best practices and benchmark >=3 leading web apps AND >=3 leading Android/finance apps. Save cited notes to research/notes.md (source URL + what you take from it).
2. AUDIT the existing UI: enumerate the full screen inventory (web + Android), note duplicate components, overflow spots, inconsistencies — save to evidence/screen_inventory.md.

3. CAPTURE current state: start the web app (./run.sh or python per README), use `stitch capture browser` for key routes; for Android use Waydroid screenshots if available, else document from code. Save under evidence/current/.
4. EXTRACT design manifest: `stitch status --flow=design --json`, then the extract step to produce DESIGN.md from the current code.

5. REDESIGN in Stitch: generate the full redesigned screen set (all inventory screens, web + mobile/Android) — simple, clean, modern, consistent tokens, responsive (360/768/1280/1920), accessible (targets >=48px, gaps >=8px, visible focus).
6. EXPORT evidence: screenshots of every redesigned screen under evidence/redesigned/, plus manifest and DESIGN.md at worktree root.
quality_bar: RD-07: no duplicate components, no overflow, one shared token system across screens and platforms
RD-08: fluid/responsive — no horizontal scroll or clipping at 360/768/1280/1920
RD-09: touch targets >=48px, gaps >=8px, readable contrast, visible focus/pressed states
RD-10: one coherent navigation model, documented in DESIGN.md
deliverables: research/notes.md (>=3 benchmark + >=3 best-practice citations with URLs)
DESIGN.md (design system: tokens, components, navigation, platform notes)
evidence/redesigned/ screenshots of every screen (web + Android)
Stitch Canvas project with the full redesigned screen set
findings.md — bugs/usability problems found in the EXISTING UI (report only, do not fix)
reporting: When complete (or blocked), reply exactly: DONE: <one-line summary>. Evidence: <paths>. or BLOCKED: <reason>. Keep the reply short; put detail in files.

tools.primary: Stitch CLI (stitch status/capture/generate/upload — see the stitch skill in .agents/skills/stitch)
tools.android: Waydroid optional; if unavailable, derive Android screens from android/app code + redesign natively in Stitch mobile

theme_directive: SINGLE theme per track (developer ruling 2026-11-23, D11): choose your OWN single best color theme — simple, clean, best. Do NOT design multiple themes or theme variants. Document that one palette (colors, states, semantic roles) as the core of your DESIGN.md token system. The existing app's light/dark switcher fate is an implementation-stage question (OP5) — for your design, one theme only.
